title: Handley Page Halifax's JP201 and LL137
memorial_details:
description: Tablet, top : IN MEMORY / OF THE CREWS OF TWO HALIFAX AIRCRAFT WHICH COLLIDED / OVER THIS PARISH ON THE NIGHT OF 15th NOVEMBER 1944
 
Tablet, centre left : CREW OF HALIFAX  JP201 / (5 NAMES) / (1 NAME) WAS THE ONLY / SURVIVOR, HE IS LISTED AS " MISSING " ON / 18. 4. 45 WHILE FLYING ON OPERATIONS

Tablet, centre right : CREW OF HALIFAX  LL137 / (8 NAMES)

Tablet, bottom : THIS MEMORIAL WAS ERECTED TO THEIR HONOUR ON NOVEMBER 6th 1994
